* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). '''Dark Side:''' If Vader's Malediction on table and Vader alone here, opponent's Interrupts are Lost Interrupts.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Cloud City: Chasm Walkway (V)]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Cloud City: Chasm Walkway (V)]] (published 18 June 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Cloud City: Chasm Walkway (DARK)”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Cloud City: Chasm Walkway (Dark)]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
